title: Heimerdinger inherits [Exhaust] abilities from the Chosen Champion still sitting in the Champion Zone (non-board zone).
expected: packages/riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/chain/activate-ability.ts:316 — collectFriendlyBoardCards() pushes getCardsInZone("championZone") alongside base/legendZone/battlefields, and the inheritExhaustAbilities loop (lines 250-287) uses that list with only a cardType filter (legend/unit/gear/equipment), so an unplayed Chosen Champion (e.g. Lee Sin ogn-078-298, cardType unit) in the Champion Zone contributes its exhaust-cost activated abilities to Heimerdinger. Champion Zone is a non-board zone (rule 108.3; champion must be played from there per 108.3.d), so the card is not a friendly unit in play and should be excluded.
observed: With Lee Sin, Ascetic (ogn-078-298) unplayed in championZone, `moves` listed activateAbility {cardId: Heimerdinger, sourceCardId: 'player-1-champion-ogn-078-298', abilityIndex:1}; activating it exhausted Heimerdinger and put a 'buff self' ability on the chain which resolved. Source: collectFriendlyBoardCards() in packages/riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/chain/activate-ability.ts explicitly pushes championZone.

history.note: champion zone excluded from Heimerdinger inheritable board cards (rule 108.3)
